report.title: The Autonomous Corporation of One: Legal Frameworks and the Algorithmic Entity
report.summary: The intersection of artificial intelligence and corporate jurisprudence has precipitated a profound legal anomaly: the prospect of an autonomous entity, an organization governed entirely by software, operating with the legal privileges of a traditional corporation but devoid of human management.…
